consent.title: {client} wants to access your Kreo account
consent.notYou: Not you? Sign out of Kreo and try again.
consent.verifiedBy: Client identity verified by its domain: {host}
consent.unverified: The name is declared by the app itself. Check the return address before allowing.
consent.redirectTo: It will send you back to
consent.loopbackWarning: This app returns to a local address on your computer (localhost). Only allow it if you just opened it yourself, e.g. Claude Code.
consent.workspaceHelp: The app can only use this workspace, with your role in it.
consent.canTitle: On your behalf it will be able to

can.read: View projects, the publishing calendar, free slots, tasks and metrics.
can.drafts: Create post drafts and tasks, and send them for approval (if you are an editor).
can.ai: Generate AI images and videos using the workspace's credits (it always tells you the cost).

consent.cannotTitle: It will never be able to
consent.cannot: Approve, publish or send anything, or change your password, plan or connected accounts.
consent.duration: Access lasts until you revoke it in Settings › API keys & MCP › Connected apps (tokens expire every hour and renew automatically for up to 30 days of use).
consent.noWorkspaces: You don't belong to any workspace. Create one in Kreo before connecting apps.

errors.expired: The request has expired. Connect again from the app (e.g. Claude).
errors.login: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Authorization failed. If you use 2FA, verify it again.

consent.impersonationWarning: This app claims to be “{client}” but sends access to {host}, which isn't Claude. If you don't recognise it, click Cancel.

reasons.invalid_client: The app isn't registered with Kreo or its identifier is invalid. Add the connector again from the app.
reasons.invalid_redirect_uri: The app's return address doesn't match the registered one. For your safety we won't redirect you.
reasons.not_configured: Connecting apps isn't configured on this Kreo server yet.
reasons.expired: The request has expired. Connect again from the app.

apps.title: Connected apps
apps.body: Apps you authorized with OAuth (e.g. Claude). They act in one workspace with your role. Revoking cuts access immediately.
apps.empty: No connected apps. Add Kreo as a connector in Claude (steps below).
apps.error: Couldn't revoke. If you use 2FA, verify it again.
